narrative: Constable Brijesh Singh was caught on video harassing a young woman in Kanpur. The woman dragged him to the police station after he allegedly harassed her. Attempts were made to hide the constable's identity, but his name was identified and published on social media. The incident sparked outrage and calls for action against the officer. The case was widely shared on social media platforms.
status_detail: Complaint lodged. Officer identified as Constable Brijesh Singh. Departmental action awaited.

sources.description: Viral video of Constable Brijesh Singh harassing woman
Video showing police harassment — woman dragged constable to station

editor_notes: Identity was initially attempted to be hidden. Officer name confirmed by multiple sources.
